migration.locking: ALTER TABLE repositories takes an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock. With six rows and constant defaults on the deployed PostgreSQL version, expected duration was brief; the new-table backfill does not rewrite the repositories table.

migration.recoveryIfCandidateFailed: Keep the routed prior image active, preserve the isolated candidate and evidence, and request targeted repair authorization.
